description: Face masks (opt-in, all five sections together): merge into a processing manifest. faceDensity gives the face charts 3x the texel density of the rest; masks parse the head's own front render; featureChannels moves iris to tattoo1, eyes/lips/nose to skin, brows and hair locks to hair; faceTreatment is step 3 of docs/heads/head-texture-quality-plan.md (these are its defaults); quality gates export. Validated on elf heads only (2026-10-30): check other races in the client before use. The bindings need libraries.mediapipe and libraries.onnxruntime (the .tools/headkit-facemasks-v1 folder) and Embree 4.4.0.
